searchText: PTAL, https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/418 Can be MethodNotSupported = -32004 pre Cancun or like that, wdyt? Do you mean introducing a separate error code if there is a timestamp mismatch wrt a minimal hard fork supported by a method, sort of `-38005: Unsupported fork`? Method not supported doesn't sound right to me as actually method *is* supported but aren't allowed to be used for payloads of previous forks Yep, exactly. "Invalid params" do not sound for this case. MethodNotSupported seemed to be better but indeed not ideal
